## What's changed

- Support Herdr App replicas on Windows and WSL, including cancellation of a replica that is still starting.
- Work from a WSL terminal of the Windows Herdr App without setup: find the App's command-line program (`PI_HERDR_APP_CLI`, `HERDR_APP_BIN`, `PATH`, or the Windows installer folder) and detect the machine the App lists the terminal under (`PI_HERDR_APP_MACHINE` overrides).
- Silence Git progress output during replica worktree operations.

[pi-agent-replicate on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/pi-agent-replicate/v/1.4.2)
